assertions.name: v21_generators_satisfy_hecke_braid_relation
assertions.source: σ₁σ₂σ₁ − σ₂σ₁σ₂ on the compiled seminormal V_(2,1) at q_0 — two distinct products of the same generators. If they part company the matrices are not the H_3 braid action and every trace in this probe is over the wrong object.

assertions.name: hoefsmit_b_matches_seminormal_sigma2_offdiagonal
assertions.source: b two ways at q_0: the off-diagonal entry of the seminormal σ₂ built by char_fast from the Young-orthogonal recipe, vs the closed form √(q⁴+q²+1)/(q²+1). b scales every ratio in Test 1 and the N=1 factor in Test 3.

description: Path 1 (operator-identification on V_(2,1) at H_3) for the Q_β precision-ladder. NEGATIVE RESULT: no candidate operator on V_(2,1) matches the empirical c_3..c_7 via Markov trace. path_1_attempted.meaning: Path 1 operator-identification was run and its negative outcome documented

caveats: SCOPE (recorded, not repaired): the headline negative result — "no candidate operator on V_(2,1) matches the empirical c_3..c_7" — is asserted in prose only. This script never loads the empirical c_k and never computes a distance to them; Tests 1-3 print traces and ratios and the reader is left to see that none of them land. Making the null falsifiable needs the c_k in hand, and the canonical source (qbeta-decay-sdp-extended-ck.witness.json) has since had every c_k nulled as unresolved.
